insight.headline: Signed deals sit an average 2.6 days in DocuSign before Salesforce shows Closed Won
insight.detail: Joining DocuSign completion timestamps against Salesforce stage-change history shows 7 of the last 12 wins were booked days after signature — Caldera itself signed at 07:12 and would have waited for Monday's admin sweep. Neither system alone sees the lag: DocuSign doesn't know the opp exists, and Salesforce doesn't know the ink is dry.
insight.action: Auto-run this chain on every completed envelope so bookings land the hour they sign

insight.headline: $490K of August commit has zero customer meetings booked in the next 14 days
insight.detail: Cross-matching Salesforce close dates against Calendar shows Bluewater ($310K) and Helios ($180K) claim August closes with no meeting on anyone's calendar, while Slack shows procurement silent 12 days. Salesforce alone reports healthy stages — only the calendar and message layers expose that nobody is actually talking to these buyers.
